name: Condo Control
positioning: Condo and HOA management software organised around the building's daily life: communication, amenities, security desk and maintenance, with accounting alongside.
description: Condo Control is software for condominium and homeowner association management, sold to management companies, self-managed communities and security companies. Its modules cover communication (announcements, discussion forum, association websites, virtual meetings and an AI manager assistant), financial work (accounting, billing and collections, portfolio accounting, reports and budgeting, online payments, vendor management), maintenance (requests, architectural change, preventive maintenance, community assets), record keeping (resident database, file library, violation tracking, proxy and fractional voting, electronic consent), security (authorised entry, incident reports, key tracking, security logs and patrol, package management) and the resident side (guest passes, event calendar, amenity booking, package tracking, visitor parking). The vendor also sells managed accounting and moderated meeting services alongside the software.
real_estate_use: A condominium tower runs on things a rental building never has to think about: a front desk logging visitors, a party room booked three weeks ahead, a package wall that overflows every December, a proxy count that has to hold up at the annual general meeting. Condo Control is the product that treats those as first-class, which is why concierge and security staff use it as much as the property manager. A manager reaches for it when the building's problem is coordination rather than accounting, and when the board wants residents to self-serve on bookings, documents and payments instead of calling the office. Its pricing is quoted per unit band with distinct plans for self-managed communities and for management companies.
features: Amenity booking, guest passes and visitor parking
Package tracking and package room management
Front desk security logs, patrol, incident reports and key tracking
Proxy and fractional voting with electronic consent
Maintenance requests, preventive maintenance and architectural change requests

use_cases.job: Run an AGM with a proxy count that holds up, without paper
Book the party room and see whether a package has arrived without calling the desk
Track a maintenance request from a resident report to a vendor visit
